Features

AI chat, moderation, automation, personality, social features, and multi-provider AI in one Discord-native platform.

Features

Every feature is designed for real Discord server management.

AI Chat

Conversational AI with multi-provider routing, automatic fallback, and intelligent model selection.

Multi-Provider AI

Access Google Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral, Anthropic, OpenAI, and 20+ more providers.

Custom Personality

Configure AI tone, style, and behavior per server with validation and audit logging.

AI Moderation

Spam detection, link filtering, anti-invite, anti-scam, and configurable moderation actions.

Automation

Welcome messages, role assignment, event triggers with safe predefined actions only.

Social/Debate

Rivalry sessions, decision systems, and configurable social behavior with cooldowns.

Anime Actions

Custom emoji provisioning and anime-style interactions for community engagement.

Analytics

Real AI request tracking, provider health metrics, and usage statistics.

Provider Management

Full lifecycle management with the provider wizard, credential rotation, and model discovery.

Security

SSRF protection, CSRF, session security, MFA, OAuth, and credential-first classification.
